name: gddiff Window Probe
description: Finds the timing window of every click of a Geometry Dash level: plays the level itself (or takes a macro), shifts each click until the player dies, and shows the difficulty

enabled.name: Measure probe_input.txt on level start
enabled.description: When a level opens, read probe_input.txt from the mod save folder and start measuring. Turn off for normal play. The pause menu button works without this.

solve-horizon.name: Solver look-ahead (ticks)
solve-horizon.description: How far ahead the solver looks after a trial click. 180 ticks = 0.75 s.

solve-max-delay.name: Solver click search range (ticks)
solve-max-delay.description: How far ahead of the next obstacle the solver tries clicks.

solve-stride.name: Solver coarse step (ticks)
solve-stride.description: Tries every Nth tick first, then refines around the ones that work. 1 = slowest and most exact.

solve-max-checkpoints.name: Solver checkpoints kept
solve-max-checkpoints.description: How many checkpoints the solver may keep to step back when it hits a dead end.

sigma-ms.name: Player aim spread (ms)
sigma-ms.description: Assumed spread of the player's clicks when computing difficulty. Only scales the numbers.

max-shift.name: Max shift (ticks)
max-shift.description: How far each click is shifted in each direction. 48 ticks = 200 ms at 240 TPS.

horizon.name: Survival horizon (ticks)
horizon.description: How long the player must survive after a shifted click. Too short misses delayed deaths and overestimates windows.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Game speed while measuring. Higher is faster if your PC keeps up.

exact-restart.name: Exact restart
exact-restart.description: Start every trial from the level start instead of a checkpoint. Exact but very slow: use with stride or a click range to check checkpoint results.

repair-restore.name: Repair checkpoint state
repair-restore.description: Restore player position, rotation and y velocity after loading a checkpoint if they differ.

verify-restore.name: Verify checkpoints
verify-restore.description: Replay the original click after each new checkpoint and stop if it dies.

frame-source.name: Tick source
frame-source.description: level-time matches xdBot macros, progress matches other bots.

replay-test.name: Replay test instead of measuring
replay-test.description: Measure macro plays the macro once and saves where the player was on every tick (trace_<id>.csv). For finding why a macro dies.
